<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every credential in the organization.

This endpoint is not paginated — you get the complete list in one response, however many there
are.

**Each credential in the response includes its password in clear text**, along with a ready-made
connection string. That is deliberate: we store passwords so the dashboard can display and
rotate them. It does mean this response is as sensitive as a password file, so avoid logging it
and never pass it to an untrusted client. If you only need to know a credential exists, this is
still the wrong endpoint to leave in a debug log.
